backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing invoices, payments, and user profiles with role-based access control and admin-restricted data operations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, and test mappings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for reference.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go‑live checklist documenting authentication, feature verification, UI/UX checks, data integrity, and post‑deployment steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme variables, dark mode styles, and base element rules.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entry file loading the root React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application routing setup with authentication, role checks, admin-only routes, and layout integration.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a non-admin attempts to access restricted pages, with messaging and navigation options.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal for creating a user profile, allowing name entry and saving via actor API with loading and error handling.
Displays a dismissible alert prompting users to complete their profile and opens the profile setup modal.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout with navigation, role‑based links, user info, logout handling, and profile setup prompting.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Editor for managing multiple payment lines, supporting add/remove actions and mode‑specific input fields.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Filter panel for reports, enabling date, salesman, payment type, and payment mode selection.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payments grouped by retailer with formatted totals, dates, types, modes, and amounts.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: React table component that displays invoices with pagination, sorting by ageing days, and status badges.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor based on Internet Identity and invalidates queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that fetches the current user's profile and role using the actor and Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context, loading stored identities and handling login and logout via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating invoices, payments, and related data via the actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables for light and dark modes and applying global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Displays admin dashboard with report stats and navigation cards using fetched summary data.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Provides invoice upload, filtering, clearing, and template download with a table of existing invoices.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: Lists system users and allows admins to change roles with confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page that triggers Internet Identity authentication and handles errors with UI feedback.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Loads a specific payment, allows editing amount and mode, and saves updates.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Handles recording new payments for an invoice with multiple lines, validation, and submission.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Renders a payment history table for a retailer with formatting helpers and admin actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Displays report filters, summary stats, and a ledger table with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine interface describing fields for cash, cheque, and online payment details.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV-style XLSX invoice files, validates required columns, and converts rows into Invoice objects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Generates and downloads a CSV report from aggregated payment data and filters.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Creates and downloads a CSV template for invoice uploads with required headers.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides filtering logic for invoices based on retailer, invoice, and salesman fields.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Parses invoice dates, calculates ageing days, and formats the result.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes various invoice status formats into a canonical status string.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates total, remaining, and excess payments and derives payment status.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing), persist them in sessionStorage, and clear them from the URL.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entries by checking required fields and ensuring positive, non-negative amounts for cash, cheque, and online modes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, typography, animations, and plugins for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Records the project’s state, goals, architecture notes, issues, and planned shift to email/password authentication.
